definitions.explanation: A painting created using oil-based paints, or the art form itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{油絵|あぶらえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I viewed oil paintings at the art museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{油絵|あぶらえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いている→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I paint oil paintings as a hobby.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{油絵|あぶらえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧だ。
examples.english: This oil painting is a work by a famous painter.
